vehicles.name: SM_Moto_SH
vehicles.units: metres, Unity axes (x right, y up, z forward); origin = ground, wheelbase midpoint
vehicles.material: M_HanoiMoto: atlas Blender/moto/T_MotoAtlas.png + T_MotoAtlasData.png; paint tint where UV is in the PAINT cell (u < 0.125, v > 0.875); alpha clip 0.5 (atlas alpha: see-through between the wheel spokes)

rig.hierarchy: FBX is flat: SM_Moto_SH_Rig > Body_LODn, Steer_LODn, WheelF_LODn, WheelR_LODn (origins on their pivots), anchors. In Unity: Steer pivot holds Steer_LODn + WheelF pivot (WheelF_LODn); rotate Steer about steer_axis, wheels about local X.

vehicles.name: SM_Car_LuxA2
vehicles.units: metres, Unity axes (x right, y up, z forward); origin = ground, wheelbase midpoint; the tyres touch y = 0 (checked per LOD in contact)
vehicles.material: Hanoi/Vehicle: _BaseMap T_CarBody.png (albedo, paint baked neutral grey), _DataMap T_CarBodyData.png (R rough, G metal, B lamps, A paint mask -> albedo x _PaintColor), normal T_CarBody_N.png (tangent space). Body UVs in [0, 0.8]^2, rim tile u,v 0.8-1, tyre u 0.8-1 v 0.6-0.8

rig.hierarchy: FBX is flat: SM_Car_LuxA2_Rig > Body_LODn, Wheel{FL,FR,RL,RR}_LODn (origins on the axles). Unity: Steer{FL,FR} pivots on the front axles hold the front wheels (rotate about Y); every wheel spins about its local X.

vehicles.name: SM_Rider_M
vehicles.units: metres, Unity axes; origin = the SM_Moto_SH origin (ground, wheelbase midpoint): make it a child of the bike with no offset
vehicles.material: Hanoi/Vehicle, _PaintMaskMode 2: _BaseMap T_RiderM.png (shirt + helmet shell baked grey 0.8), _DataMap T_RiderMData.png (R rough, G metal, B helmet mask -> _PaintColor2, A shirt mask -> _PaintColor)
